extensionDescription.message: Fills in your Jira/Clockwork worklogs for a day from your Jira activity, the commits linked to your issues, and your recurring meetings.

optionsLede.message: Hours are written to native Jira worklogs, which Clockwork keeps in sync: they show up in My Work and in timesheets without going through the Clockwork API. Authentication uses your browser session — no tokens, no stored credentials: you just need a tab open and logged in on the site below.

hintSite.message: The prefix is enough: Jira Cloud always lives on .atlassian.net, and it is the only host this extension has permissions for. If you paste the full URL it gets cleaned up. Only tabs open on this site are used for the session: another Atlassian site is ignored.

hintProjects.message: Comma-separated keys. Narrows both the activity search and the issue keys accepted in commit messages.

checkComments.message: Count my comments as activity too

checkDevPanel.message: Read commits from the issue Development panel

hintDevPanel.message: Commits are read from Jira itself — the same panel you see at the bottom of every ticket. No Bitbucket tab to keep open, no workspace to configure.

hintDevCandidates.message: The panel is queried one issue at a time, so the number matters. Besides the issues you touched today, your issues updated in the last three weeks are checked too: that is how commits on tickets you did not open in Jira get found. Higher means more coverage but a slower analysis. 0 means today's issues only.

fieldAuthors.message: Names or emails you sign commits with

hintAuthors.message: Comma-separated. Your Jira name and email are already taken into account: this field is only needed if you sign git commits with a different name (an old address, your home laptop).

hintBreaks.message: Breaks do not consume your daily budget: they are holes in the timeline. A block of work that lands on one gets split, and several worklogs reach Jira — the way the day actually looks on the calendar. Add as many as you need.

hintMeetings.message: Fixed duration, subtracted from the daily budget before the rest is split across tasks. The ticket is picked in the popup and remembered for the whole week.

msgNotSavedTimes.message: Not saved: in $NAMES$ the end time is not after the start time.

msgNoAtlassianTab.message: No tab open on an Atlassian site.

colophonContact.message: For bugs or requests contact me on Telegram

emptyNothing.message: Nothing to log for this day.

totalOverflowRedo.message: · the day would reach $TOTAL$: you are re-adding $REDONE$ already logged

commentAnalysis.message: Analysis and discussion on the ticket

whyTime.message: proposed because a worklog already exists on this ticket at that time

whyName.message: proposed because it resembles the meeting name

whyDate.message: proposed because the title contains today's date

titleSplitByBreak.message: Split by the break: several worklogs will be written.

titleWipe.message: Show the $AMOUNT$ already logged today on $ISSUE$, to delete them

titleRemoveRow.message: Remove from the plan (does not touch Jira)

worklogsMany.message: $COUNT$ worklogs already on Jira for $ISSUE$ — delete them individually:

worklogsUnlistable.message: Cannot list the individual worklogs for $ISSUE$ ($AMOUNT$ in total). Reload the extension, or delete them all:

msgSentSplit.message: $COUNT$ rows logged ($PARTS$ worklogs, some split by the break): $ISSUES$.

msgClash.message: $ISSUE$ was also among the tasks: removed, it stays as a meeting.

msgMeetingsNoTicket.message: $COUNT$ meeting(s) without a ticket: pick the issue from the suggestions field.

msgProposedTickets.message: Meeting ticket proposed automatically ($ISSUES$): check it is the right one before sending.

msgReloadNone.message: No Jira tab to reload: the calendar below may still show the previous data.

msgReloadFailed.message: Could not reload the Jira page: $ERROR$

errNoTab.message: No tab open on $HOST$, so I cannot use your session.$EXTRA$

errNoTabOthers.message: You have $OTHERS$ open, but the configuration points to $HOST$.

errSessionInvalid.message: The tab on $HOST$ is there but the session is not valid: log in again and retry.

planDayAlreadyFull.message: The $LOGGED$ already logged cover the $BUDGET$ daily budget: nothing left to distribute, all rows start disabled.

planNoTasks.message: No work task found for this day, neither from Jira activity nor from commits.

planMeetingsCoverAll.message: Meetings ($MEETINGS$) cover all the remaining time ($BUDGET$): tasks stay at zero.

planTooManyTasks.message: Too many tasks ($COUNT$) for the $REMAINING$ left in $STEP$-minute steps: some rows are at zero, remove a few or reduce the rounding.

planPastMidnight.message: The schedule runs past midnight: move the day start earlier, shorten the breaks or remove some rows.

noteNoProjects.message: No project configured: the activity search looks at every issue updated on the site (100 at most) and on a busy instance it can miss yours. Set your project keys in the options.

noteOtherAuthors.message: $COUNT$ commits today are by other authors and were not counted. If any were yours, add the name you sign commits with in the options.

noteNoCommits.message: No linked commit found on the $COUNT$ issues checked: either the Development panel is not connected, or the ticket was not among the candidates.

noteDevPanelUnreadable.message: Development panel not readable ($ERROR$). Continuing with Jira activity only.

noteWorklogsUnreadable.message: Could not read the worklogs already present: check that you are not doubling the hours.

errNoHost.message: No Jira site configured, and no Atlassian tab open to infer it from.

errNoIdentity.message: I cannot read your Jira identity.

errMissingIssue.message: Missing the issue to clean up.

errTabGone.message: The tab on $HOST$ used for the session no longer responds.

msgPartialWrite.message: — careful: $DONE$ of $TOTAL$ blocks were already written

checkShowBadge.message: Show the missing hours on the extension icon

hintShowBadge.message: A number on the icon when today is not covered yet, refreshed every 15 minutes. It needs a Jira tab open to read from: without one the badge is cleared rather than left showing a stale figure.

msgCopied.message: $COUNT$ rows copied from $DATE$. The hours came across as they were: correct them if the day was different.

btnConfirmDuplicateMany.message: Confirm: $COUNT$ rows already have hours today
